sections.name: 五种基本句型
rows: 不及物动词（后面不能直接加宾语）
主语 + 系动词 + 表语 (S+V+P)
主语 + 及物动词 + 宾语 (S+V+O)
及物动词（后面必须加宾语）
主语 + 及物动词 + 间接宾语 + 直接宾语 (S+V+IO+DO)
主语 + 及物动词 + 宾语 + 宾语补足语 (S+V+O+C)

questions.question: 在句子 'She is a teacher.' 中，'teacher' 是什么词性？
questions.questionCn: 在句子 'She is a teacher.' 中，'teacher' 是什么词性？
questions.explanation: teacher（老师）表示人，是名词。名词在句子中可以作主语、宾语、表语等。这里 teacher 跟在 be 动词 is 后面，作表语，说明主语 she 的身份。

questions.question: 在句子 'The cat is sleeping.' 中，'is sleeping' 是什么成分？
questions.questionCn: 在句子 'The cat is sleeping.' 中，'is sleeping' 是什么成分？
questions.explanation: is sleeping 是谓语，表示主语 The cat 的动作或状态。谓语是句子的核心，说明主语在做什么或处于什么状态。动词是谓语的核心，所以说'动词是句子的灵魂'。

questions.question: 句子 'I study English.' 属于哪种基本句型？
questions.questionCn: 句子 'I study English.' 属于哪种基本句型？
choices: C. 主语+及物动词+宾语 (S+V+O)
D. 主语+及物动词+双宾语 (S+V+IO+DO)
questions.explanation: I 是主语，study 是及物动词（后面可以直接加宾语），English 是宾语（动作的承受者）。所以是 S+V+O 句型——主语+及物动词+宾语。判断方法：动词后面直接跟了一个名词/代词，就是宾语。

questions.question: 形容词用来修饰动词，副词用来修饰名词。
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：形容词用来修饰动词，副词用来修饰名词。
questions.explanation: 错误。说反了！形容词修饰名词（a big apple 中 big 修饰 apple），副词修饰动词、形容词或其他副词（run quickly 中 quickly 修饰 run）。记忆口诀：形修名，副修动/形/副。
questions.knowledgePoint: 词性：形容词和副词的区别

questions.question: 在句子 'She gave me a book.' 中，有几个宾语？
questions.questionCn: 在句子 'She gave me a book.' 中，有几个宾语？
questions.explanation: 这个句子有两个宾语：me（间接宾语，表示动作对谁做）和 a book（直接宾语，表示动作的对象是什么）。授予动词如 give, teach, buy, show 等可以带双宾语，结构是 S+V+IO+DO。

items.rule: 语法一致原则：主语单复数决定谓语单复数
examples: The book is on the desk.（单数主语→单数谓语）
The books are on the desk.（复数主语→复数谓语）

items.rule: 意义一致原则：主语形式为单但意义为复，谓语用复数
examples: The police are searching for the thief.（police形式单数，意义复数）
The family are sitting at the table.（family表成员时用复数）

items.rule: 就近原则：谓语与最近的主语保持一致
examples: Either you or I am wrong.（am与I最近）
There is a pen and two books on the desk.（is与a pen最近）

items.rule: and连接两个主语一般用复数谓语，但表示单一概念时用单数
examples: Tom and Mary are good friends.（两个人→复数）
Bread and butter is my breakfast.（一套食物→单数）

items.rule: 不定代词each/every/no修饰的名词作主语，谓语用单数
examples: Each student has a book.
Every boy and every girl was invited.

items.rule: 表示时间、金钱、距离、重量的复数名词作主语，谓语用单数
examples: Ten years is a long time.
Five dollars is enough.

items.rule: the + 形容词表一类人，谓语用复数
examples: The old are taken good care of.
The rich are not always happy.

questions.question: She ___ a teacher last year.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：她去年是一名老师。
questions.explanation: 主语she是第三人称单数，时间last year表示过去，be动词用was。is是现在时；were是复数或第二人称过去时；be是原形。
questions.knowledgePoint: be动词过去时第三人称单数用was

questions.question: 现在完成时的构成是？
questions.questionCn: 现在完成时的构成是？
questions.explanation: 现在完成时 = have/has + 过去分词(done)。A是现在进行时；C是过去完成时；D是一般将来时。
questions.knowledgePoint: 十二时态构成：现在完成时

questions.question: Neither Tom nor I ___ interested in football.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：汤姆和我都对足球不感兴趣。
questions.explanation: neither...nor...连接两个主语时，谓语遵循就近原则，与最近的主语I保持一致，所以用am。

questions.question: Three years ___ a short time in history.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：三年在历史中是短暂的。
questions.explanation: 表示时间、金钱、距离、重量的复数名词作主语时，如果表示整体概念，谓语动词用单数。"三年"被视为一个整体时间段。
questions.knowledgePoint: 主谓一致：时间/金钱等复数名词表整体用单数

questions.question: 过去进行时的构成是 was/were + doing。
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：过去进行时的构成是 was/were + doing。
questions.explanation: 正确。过去进行时由 was/were + 现在分词(v-ing)构成。was用于第一、三人称单数，were用于其他人称。
questions.knowledgePoint: 十二时态构成：过去进行时

sections.name: AAA型 / AAB型 / ABA型 分组表
ABB型 分组表（过去式=过去分词）
ABC型 分组表（三形各异）

questions.question: What is the past tense of 'go'?
questions.questionCn: 选择：'go'的过去式是？
questions.explanation: go是ABC型不规则动词：go - went - gone。过去式是went，过去分词是gone。

questions.question: Which of the following is an AAA-type verb?
questions.questionCn: 下列哪个是AAA型动词（三形相同）？
questions.explanation: cut是AAA型：cut - cut - cut，三形相同。begin是ABC型（i-a-u型）；buy是ABB型；go是ABC型。

questions.question: She has ___ a beautiful song.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：她唱了一首美丽的歌。
questions.explanation: 现在完成时需要用过去分词。sing是ABC型：sing - sang - sung，过去分词是sung。
questions.knowledgePoint: 不规则动词ABC型：sing的过去分词

questions.question: I ___ my homework yesterday.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确形式：我昨天做了作业。
questions.explanation: yesterday表示过去，用一般过去时。do是ABC型：do - did - done，过去式是did。
questions.knowledgePoint: 不规则动词ABC型：do的过去式

questions.question: 'Bring' is an ABB-type verb: bring - brought - brought.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：'bring'是ABB型动词：bring - brought - brought。
questions.explanation: 正确。bring属于ABB型（ought/aught类）：bring - brought - brought，过去式和过去分词相同。

sections.name: 七大万能动词用法总表
rows: 系动词+表语；助动词构成进行/被动
be + 名词/形容词/介词短语
be good at, be interested in, be afraid of
have + 名词（拥有/吃喝/经历）
have a good time, have breakfast, have to
助动词构成疑问/否定/强调
do homework, do sports, do one's best
take + 宾语（带走/花费/乘坐）
take a bus, take care of, take part in
make a cake, make friends, make money
go to school, go shopping, go home
get + 宾语/形容词（得到/变得）
get up, get on, get along with

sections.name: be/have/do 三大动词功能对比

items.rule: be动词：系动词（表状态）+ 助动词（构成进行时/被动语态）
examples: 系动词：She is happy.（她很高兴）
助动词（进行时）：She is reading.（她正在读）
助动词（被动）：The book was written by him.（这本书是他写的）

items.rule: have：助动词（构成完成时态）+ 实义动词（有/吃/经历）
examples: 助动词：I have finished my work.（我已经完成了工作）
实义动词：I have a car.（我有一辆车）
实义动词：Let's have lunch.（我们吃午饭吧）

items.rule: do：助动词（构成疑问/否定/强调）+ 实义动词（做/干）
examples: 助动词（疑问）：Do you like music?（你喜欢音乐吗？）
助动词（否定）：I don't know.（我不知道）
助动词（强调）：I do love you.（我真的爱你）
实义动词：I do my homework every day.（我每天做作业）

questions.question: She ___ her homework every evening.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：她每天晚上做作业。
questions.explanation: do homework是固定搭配，表示"做作业"。make是制作；take是拿/花费；get是得到。

questions.question: It ___ me two hours to finish the work.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：完成这项工作花了我两个小时。
questions.explanation: It takes sb. some time to do sth.是固定句型，表示"做某事花费某人多长时间"。

questions.question: Which sentence uses 'have' as an auxiliary verb?
questions.questionCn: 哪个句子中的have用作助动词？
choices: B. I have finished my homework.
questions.explanation: B选项中have finished构成现在完成时，have是助动词。A（有）、C（吃）、D（患）都是实义动词。

questions.question: The food ___ good.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：这食物尝起来很好。
questions.explanation: taste是系动词，表示"尝起来"，后面接形容词good作表语。make/get/go在这里不符合语义。

sections.name: 名词复数变化规则表
rows: 清辅音后读/s/，浊辅音和元音后读/z/
bus → buses, box → boxes, watch → watches
knife → knives, leaf → leaves, wife → wives
tomato → tomatoes, potato → potatoes, hero → heroes
photo → photos, piano → pianos, radio → radios
roof → roofs, chief → chiefs, belief → beliefs

sections.name: 不规则复数与不可数名词

items.rule: 不规则复数：改变元音或词尾
examples: man → men, woman → women
tooth → teeth, foot → feet
goose → geese, mouse → mice
child → children, ox → oxen

items.rule: 单复数同形的名词
examples: sheep → sheep, deer → deer
fish → fish（强调种类时用fishes）
Chinese → Chinese, Japanese → Japanese
means → means, species → species

items.rule: 只有复数形式的名词
examples: clothes, trousers, pants, jeans（衣物类）
glasses, scissors, chopsticks（成对物品）
people, police, cattle（集体名词）

items.rule: 常见不可数名词（物质/抽象）
examples: water, milk, rice, bread, meat, gold（物质）
news, information, advice, knowledge, progress（抽象）
weather, traffic, furniture, equipment, homework（其他）

items.rule: 不可数名词量化表达：量词 + of + 不可数名词
examples: a cup of tea, two cups of tea
a piece of news, three pieces of advice
a bottle of water, a loaf of bread

sections.name: 名词所有格
rows: 有生命名词复数（非s结尾）
the door of the room, the name of the school

questions.question: There are many ___ on the farm.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：农场里有很多绵羊。
questions.explanation: sheep是单复数同形的名词，复数还是sheep。类似的还有deer, fish, Chinese等。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词不规则复数：单复数同形

questions.question: The baby has two new ___.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：这个宝宝长了两颗新牙。
questions.explanation: tooth的复数是teeth，属于改变元音的不规则变化。类似的还有：foot → feet, goose → geese。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词不规则复数：改变元音

questions.question: This is ___ room.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：这是汤姆和杰瑞的房间。（两人共用一间）
questions.explanation: 表示共同所有时，只在最后一个名词后加-'s。如果是Tom's and Jerry's则表示各自的房间（两间）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词所有格：共同所有vs分别所有

questions.question: I need some ___ about the trip.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：我需要一些关于旅行的信息。
questions.explanation: information是不可数名词，没有复数形式，也不能用a/an修饰。可以说some information或a piece of information。

questions.question: The plural of 'potato' is 'potatos'.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：potato的复数是potatos。
questions.explanation: 错误。以o结尾的有生命名词变复数加-es：potato → potatoes, tomato → tomatoes, hero → heroes。
questions.knowledgePoint: 名词复数：以o结尾的有生命名词加-es

sections.name: 形容词/副词比较级最高级规则表

items.rule: 一般形容词直接加-ly
examples: quick → quickly
slow → slowly
careful → carefully

items.rule: 以辅音字母+y结尾，变y为i加-ly
examples: happy → happily
easy → easily
heavy → heavily

items.rule: 以-le结尾，去e加-y
examples: terrible → terribly
possible → possibly
simple → simply

items.rule: 形副同形的词
examples: fast → fast（快的/快地）
early → early（早的/早地）
late → late（晚的/晚地）
hard → hard（努力的/努力地）
high → high（高的/高地）

items.rule: 特殊情况：hardly几乎不；lately最近
examples: He works hard.（他努力工作）
He hardly works.（他几乎不工作）
I have seen him lately.（我最近见过他）

questions.question: Tom is ___ than his brother.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：汤姆比他哥哥高。
questions.explanation: tall是单音节形容词，比较级直接加-er。句中有than表示比较，用比较级taller。
questions.knowledgePoint: 形容词比较级：单音节词加-er

questions.question: This book is ___ than that one.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：这本书比那本好。
questions.explanation: good的比较级是better，最高级是best，属于不规则变化。
questions.knowledgePoint: 形容词不规则变化：good → better → best

questions.question: She sings very ___.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：她唱歌非常好。
questions.explanation: 修饰动词sing需要用副词。well是good的副词形式，表示"好地"。这里没有比较含义，用原级well。

questions.question: He is a ___ worker. He works ___.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：他是一个勤奋的工人。他工作努力。
questions.explanation: hard既是形容词（勤奋的）也是副词（努力地）。hardly是"几乎不"的意思，和hard没有直接关系。

questions.question: 'Beautiful' 的比较级是 'beautifuler'.
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：beautiful的比较级是beautifuler。
questions.explanation: 错误。beautiful是多音节词（三音节），比较级和最高级要在前面加more/most：more beautiful, most beautiful。
questions.knowledgePoint: 多音节形容词比较级：加more

sections.name: 冠词总规则表
rows: 泛指一个，用于辅音音素开头的词前
a book, a student, a university
注意是音素不是字母：university/juː/开头用a
泛指一个，用于元音音素开头的词前
an apple, an hour, an honest boy
hour/aʊə/以元音开头用an；honest的h不发音
特指，双方都知道的，上文提到过的
the book on the desk, the sun
泛指复数名词、不可数名词、学科、球类等

items.rule: 特指的人或事物（双方都知道或上文提到过）
examples: Pass me the book, please.（那本书，双方知道）
I have a cat. The cat is white.（上文提到的猫）

items.rule: 独一无二的事物
examples: the sun, the moon, the earth
the sky, the world, the universe

items.rule: 序数词和形容词最高级前
examples: the first day, the second floor
the tallest boy, the most beautiful

items.rule: 江河湖海、山脉群岛、沙漠等地理名称
examples: the Yangtze River, the Pacific Ocean
the Himalayas, the Sahara Desert

items.rule: 由普通名词构成的专有名词
examples: the Great Wall, the United States
the People's Republic of China

items.rule: the + 形容词表一类人
examples: the poor, the rich, the old, the young
the blind, the deaf, the sick

items.rule: 姓氏复数前表一家人
examples: the Greens（格林一家）
the Smiths（史密斯一家）

items.rule: 乐器名称前（演奏）
examples: play the piano, play the violin
play the guitar

items.rule: 复数名词泛指一类人或事物
examples: Books are our friends.（书籍是我们的朋友）
Students like holidays.（学生喜欢假期）

items.rule: 不可数名词泛指
examples: Water is important.（水很重要）
Knowledge is power.（知识就是力量）

items.rule: 学科、语言、三餐、球类运动前
examples: I like English.（学科）
have breakfast/lunch/dinner（三餐）
play football/basketball/chess（球类/棋类）

items.rule: 星期、月份、季节、节日前
examples: on Monday, in March, in spring
on Christmas Day, on Children's Day

items.rule: 人名、地名、国名等专有名词前
examples: Tom is my friend.
China is a great country.
Beijing is the capital.

items.rule: 称呼语、头衔、职务前
examples: Mr. Wang, Professor Li
What's wrong, Dad?
He was elected president.

items.rule: by + 交通工具
examples: by bus, by bike, by car, by train
by plane, by ship, by subway

questions.question: He is ___ honest man.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：他是一个诚实的人。
questions.explanation: honest的h不发音，以元音音素/ɒ/开头，所以用an。注意用a还是an取决于发音，不是字母。
questions.knowledgePoint: 不定冠词：an用于元音音素开头的词前

questions.question: ___ sun rises in ___ east.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：太阳从东方升起。
questions.explanation: sun是独一无二的事物，前面必须加the；方位词east前也要加the。
questions.knowledgePoint: 定冠词the：独一无二的事物和方位词前

questions.question: She plays ___ piano very well.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：她钢琴弹得很好。
questions.explanation: 表示演奏乐器时，乐器名称前要加the。play the piano弹钢琴。注意球类运动前不加the：play football。

questions.question: I usually go to school by ___ bike.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：我通常骑自行车上学。
questions.explanation: by + 交通工具的结构中，交通工具前不加冠词。by bike骑自行车；by bus乘公交车。

questions.question: 在三餐饭前通常不用冠词，如 have breakfast。
questions.questionCn: 判断正误：在三餐饭前通常不用冠词，如 have breakfast。
questions.explanation: 正确。三餐饭前一般用零冠词：have breakfast/lunch/dinner。但如果有形容词修饰时可以加a：a big breakfast。

sections.name: 时间介词 in/on/at 对照表
rows: in 2024, in May, in spring, in the morning
on Monday, on May 1st, on Children's Day
at 8:00, at noon, at night, at midnight
I'll come back in an hour.（一小时后）
I have lived here for 5 years.
during the holiday, during the meeting

sections.name: 地点介词对照表
rows: in Beijing, in the room, in the box
on the desk, on the wall, on the floor
at home, at the door, at the station
under the tree, under the table
above the clouds, above the river
over the bridge, over the head
beside the door, next to the park

items.rule: 动词 + 介词 搭配
examples: look for 寻找, look after 照顾, look forward to 期待
wait for 等待, listen to 听, talk about 谈论
think about 考虑, depend on 依靠, arrive at/in 到达

items.rule: 形容词 + 介词 搭配
examples: be good at 擅长, be interested in 对…感兴趣
be afraid of 害怕, be proud of 以…为骄傲
be famous for 因…著名, be different from 与…不同

items.rule: 名词 + 介词 搭配
examples: the key to …的钥匙/答案, the answer to …的答案
a photo of 一张…的照片, a pair of 一双/一对
the reason for …的原因, the way to 去…的路

items.rule: 易混淆介词对比
examples: in the tree（外来物在树上）/ on the tree（长在树上）
in the wall（在墙里）/ on the wall（在墙面上）
on the street（美式）/ in the street（英式）
at the corner（在拐角外）/ in the corner（在拐角内）

questions.question: We usually have a meeting ___ Monday morning.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：我们通常在星期一上午开会。
questions.explanation: 虽然morning前一般用in the morning，但具体到某一天的早上要用on。on Monday morning在星期一上午。
questions.knowledgePoint: 时间介词：具体某天的早中晚用on

questions.question: There is a picture ___ the wall.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：墙上有一幅画。
questions.explanation: on the wall表示在墙的表面上（画挂在墙上）。in the wall表示在墙里面（如窗户、洞在墙里）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 地点介词：on the wall vs in the wall

questions.question: She is good ___ English.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：她擅长英语。
questions.explanation: be good at是固定搭配，表示"擅长…"。类似的还有be good for（对…有好处）、be good to（对…好）。

questions.question: I have been learning English ___ 5 years.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：我学英语已经五年了。
questions.explanation: for + 时间段表示持续了多长时间，用于完成时。since + 时间点表示"自从…以来"。5 years是时间段，用for。

questions.question: "There are some apples on the tree." 是正确的。
questions.questionCn: 判断正误："树上有一些苹果"用"There are some apples on the tree." 是正确的。
questions.explanation: 正确。长在树上的东西（如苹果、树叶）用on the tree；外来物在树上（如鸟、猫）用in the tree。
questions.knowledgePoint: 地点介词：on the tree vs in the tree

sections.name: 五大基本句型表
rows: I like apples. / She reads books.
She is happy. / It sounds good.
系动词+表语（名词/形容词）
He gave me a book. / She told us a story.
间接宾语（人）+直接宾语（物）
We made him monitor. / She asked me to go.
宾语+宾语补足语补充说明宾语

sections.name: 疑问句构成表
rows: Be/助动词/情态动词 + 主语 + 谓语？
Is she a student? / Do you like it?
疑问词 + 一般疑问句语序？
What is your name? / Where are you going?
一般疑问句 + or + 选择部分？
Do you like tea or coffee?
You are a student, aren't you?
What is this? / What does he do?
Who is he? / Whom did you see?
When do you get up? / Where is he from?
Why are you late? / How are you?

items.rule: be动词的否定：be + not
examples: She is not (isn't) a teacher.
They are not (aren't) students.

items.rule: 助动词/情态动词的否定：助动词/情态动词 + not + 动词原形
examples: I don't know.
He doesn't like coffee.
They didn't go there.
I can't swim.

items.rule: 全部否定词：no, not, never, neither, none, nothing, nobody
examples: I have no money.（= I don't have any money.）
He never tells lies.
Nobody knows the answer.

items.rule: 部分否定：not与all/both/every/always等连用
examples: Not all students are here.（不是所有学生都在）
I don't always get up early.（我不总是早起）

items.rule: 双重否定表肯定
examples: There is no smoke without fire.（无风不起浪）
He is not unwilling to help.（他不是不愿意帮忙）

sections.name: 从句引导词总表
rows: I don't know if he will come.
Can you tell me where he lives?
The book which/that I bought is good.
The man who is standing there is my father.
I remember the day when we met.
when/while/as, before, after, since, until, as soon as
When I got home, he was watching TV.
He was late because he missed the bus.
If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home.
Although he is young, he knows a lot.
He was so tired that he fell asleep.
He studies hard so that he can pass the exam.

questions.question: "She gave me a gift." 属于哪个基本句型？
questions.questionCn: "She gave me a gift." 属于哪个基本句型？
questions.explanation: gave是give的过去式，可以带双宾语：me（间接宾语，指人）和a gift（直接宾语，指物）。这是主谓双宾结构。
questions.knowledgePoint: 五大基本句型：主谓双宾

questions.question: ___ does he go to school? — By bike.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确疑问词：他怎么去上学？——骑自行车。
questions.explanation: 答语By bike表示交通方式，对方式提问用how。what问什么；where问地点；why问原因。

questions.question: The man ___ is standing there is my uncle.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确引导词：站在那里的那个人是我叔叔。
questions.explanation: 先行词是the man（人），关系代词在从句中作主语，用who。which指物；whom作宾语；whose作定语。

questions.question: I will go to the park ___ it doesn't rain tomorrow.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确引导词：如果明天不下雨，我就去公园。
questions.explanation: if引导条件状语从句，表示"如果"。because表原因；although表让步；until表时间。
questions.knowledgePoint: 状语从句：if引导条件状语从句

questions.question: "I don't have some money." 是正确的否定句。
questions.questionCn: 判断正误："I don't have some money." 是正确的否定句。
questions.explanation: 错误。否定句中some要变成any。正确形式是"I don't have any money." some一般用于肯定句，any用于否定句和疑问句。

sections.name: have / has / had 全变位表
do / does / did 全变位表
rows: Do + 主语 + 动词原形？
Did + 主语 + 动词原形？

sections.name: be/have/do 三大动词功能对照总表
rows: be good at, be interested in
have to, have a good time

questions.question: She ___ a beautiful dress.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：她有一条漂亮的裙子。
questions.explanation: 主语she是第三人称单数，一般现在时中have要变成has。have用于第一、二人称和复数主语。

questions.question: ___ you like playing football?
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：你喜欢踢足球吗？
questions.explanation: like是实义动词，构成一般疑问句需要用助动词do/does。主语是you，用do。be动词不能和实义动词原形同时使用。

questions.question: Which sentence uses 'have' as an auxiliary verb?
questions.questionCn: 哪个句子中的have用作助动词？
choices: C. They have finished the work.
D. We have a meeting today.
questions.explanation: C选项中have finished构成现在完成时，have是助动词。A（吃）、B（有）、D（有/开）都是实义动词。

questions.question: I ___ love you.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：我真的爱你。（表强调）
questions.explanation: do/does/did + 动词原形可以表示强调，意思是"确实、真的"。主语是I，用do。

questions.question: "He doesn't has a book." 是正确的句子。
questions.questionCn: 判断正误："He doesn't has a book." 是正确的句子。
questions.explanation: 错误。助动词doesn't后面要用动词原形have，不能用has。正确形式是"He doesn't have a book."

sections.name: 基数词与序数词对照表
分数、小数、百分比、倍数表达

items.rule: 分数：分子用基数词，分母用序数词，分子大于1时分母加-s
examples: 1/3: one third
2/3: two thirds
1/2: a half / one half
1/4: a quarter / one fourth
3/4: three quarters / three fourths

items.rule: 小数：小数点读point，小数点后逐位读
examples: 0.5: zero point five
3.14: three point one four
12.85: twelve point eight five

items.rule: 百分比：数字 + percent
examples: 50%: fifty percent
100%: one hundred percent
0.5%: zero point five percent

items.rule: 倍数表达：times / once / twice
examples: once 一倍, twice 两倍, three times 三倍
This room is twice as big as that one.（这个房间是那个的两倍大）
The population is three times larger than before.（人口比以前多三倍）

sections.name: 日期、时间、年龄表达
rows: 2024: twenty twenty-four / two thousand and twenty-four
8:15 = a quarter past eight; 8:45 = a quarter to nine
基数词 + years old / at the age of
He is 10 years old. / at the age of 10

questions.question: May is the ___ month of the year.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：五月是一年中的第五个月。
questions.explanation: five的序数词是fifth，ve要变成f再加-th。类似的还有twelve → twelfth。

questions.question: "三分之二" 用英语怎么说？
questions.questionCn: "三分之二" 用英语怎么说？
questions.explanation: 分数表达法：分子用基数词，分母用序数词，分子大于1时分母加-s。2/3 = two thirds。
questions.knowledgePoint: 分数表达：分子大于1分母加s

questions.question: 今天是5月1日，正确写法是？
questions.questionCn: 今天是5月1日，正确写法是？
questions.explanation: 日期要用序数词，1的序数词是first，缩写为1st。5月1日写作May 1st（美式）或1st May（英式）。

questions.question: 8:45 的另一种表达是？
questions.questionCn: 8:45 的另一种表达是？
questions.explanation: 8:45 差15分钟到9点，所以用a quarter to nine（to表示"差"）。a quarter past eight是8:15；half past eight是8:30。

questions.question: "ninth" 是 "nine" 的正确序数词形式。
questions.questionCn: 判断正误："ninth" 是 "nine" 的正确序数词形式。
questions.explanation: 正确。nine的序数词是ninth，要去掉不发音的e再加-th。注意区分：nineteenth（第十九）和ninetieth（第九十）。

items.rule: 形容词性物主代词：修饰名词，必须放在名词前
examples: my book, your pen, his sister
This is my classroom.

items.rule: 名词性物主代词：相当于"形容词性物主代词 + 名词"，可单独使用
examples: This book is mine. (= my book)
The pen is yours. (= your pen)
My bike is red, but his is black. (= his bike)

items.rule: of + 名词性物主代词 = 双重所有格
examples: a friend of mine (= one of my friends)
a photo of hers (= one of her photos)

items.rule: its vs it's 区别
examples: its：它的（物主代词）— The dog is eating its food.
it's = it is / it has — It's a cat. / It's been a long day.

sections.name: 不定代词分类表
rows: 肯定句；表请求建议的疑问句
I have some books. / Would you like some tea?
I don't have any money. / Is there anything wrong?
Nobody knows. / I have nothing to say.
Everyone is here. / Everything is ready.
each 每一个（强调个体）；every 每一个（强调整体）
each可作代词/形容词；every只能作形容词
Each student has a book. / Every student is here.
both 两者都；all 三者及以上都
both接复数；all可接可数/不可数
Both of them are right. / All the food is good.
either 两者任一；neither 两者都不
Either is OK. / Neither answer is correct.
few 几乎没有（可数）；little 几乎没有（不可数）
Few people know. / There is little water left.
a few 一些（可数）；a little 一些（不可数）
I have a few friends. / I need a little time.

questions.question: This book is ___.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：这本书是我的。
questions.explanation: 此处需要名词性物主代词mine，相当于my book。my是形容词性物主代词，后面必须跟名词。

questions.question: She taught ___ English.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：她自学英语。
questions.explanation: teach oneself表示"自学"，用反身代词。主语是she，反身代词是herself。

questions.question: There is ___ wrong with my computer. It doesn't work.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：我的电脑出了点问题。它不工作了。
questions.explanation: something wrong表示"出了某些问题"，用于肯定句。anything用于否定/疑问句；nothing表示"没有什么"；everything表示"一切"。

questions.question: He is a man of ___ words.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：他是一个话很少的人。
questions.explanation: words是可数名词复数，用few/a few修饰。few表示"几乎没有"（否定含义），a few表示"一些"（肯定含义）。话很少用few words。
questions.knowledgePoint: 不定代词：few vs a few

questions.question: "The dog is licking it's paws." 这句话语法正确。
questions.questionCn: 判断正误："The dog is licking it's paws."（狗在舔它的爪子）这句话语法正确。
questions.explanation: 错误。it's = it is / it has，而表示"它的"应该用its（物主代词）。正确形式是"The dog is licking its paws."

sections.name: 情态动词基本含义总表
rows: I can swim. / Can I help you?
He could run fast. / Could you help me?
can的过去式；也可表委婉请求
May I come in? / It may rain.
He might be at home. / Might I ask a question?
You must finish it. / He must be tired.
只有现在式，过去用had to
有各种时态：has to/had to/will have to
You should study hard. / It should be fine.
You ought to obey the rules.
语气比should强，表道义上应该
作情态动词多用于否定/疑问句
She dare not go out at night.
作情态动词多用于否定/疑问句

sections.name: 情态动词表推测用法
rows: 一定、肯定（只用于肯定句）
The light is on. He must be at home.
It's 8 o'clock. He should be there by now.
He may know the answer. I'm not sure.
He might come, but I'm not sure.
That can't be true. He is in Beijing.

sections.name: 情态动词 + have done 用法表
rows: 对过去事情的肯定推测
The ground is wet. It must have rained last night.
对过去事情的否定推测
He can't have finished it so soon.
对过去事情的可能性推测
可能性更小，也可表虚拟
You might have met her at the party.
You should have told me earlier.
You shouldn't have lied to me.
You ought to have helped him.
You needn't have come so early.
You could have passed the exam.
I would have helped you if I had known.

questions.question: — Must I finish it now? — No, you ___.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：——我必须现在完成吗？——不，你不必。
questions.explanation: must的一般疑问句，否定回答用needn't或don't have to（不必），而不是mustn't（禁止）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 情态动词：must疑问句的否定回答

questions.question: The light is on. He ___ be at home.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：灯亮着，他一定在家。
questions.explanation: must表示肯定推测，意思是"一定、肯定"。can表推测时多用于否定句和疑问句；may是可能；should是按道理应该。
questions.knowledgePoint: 情态动词表推测：must表肯定推测

questions.question: You ___ me earlier, but you didn't.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：你本应该早点告诉我，但你没有。
questions.explanation: should have done表示"本应该做某事却没做"，含有责备意味。根据but you didn't可知是过去本该做而没做。
questions.knowledgePoint: 情态动词+have done：should have done

questions.question: That ___ be true. He is in Shanghai now.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：那不可能是真的。他现在在上海。
questions.explanation: can't表示否定推测，意思是"不可能"。mustn't是"禁止"，不是推测；may not是"可能不"；needn't是"不必"。
questions.knowledgePoint: 情态动词表推测：can't表否定推测

questions.question: "Could you help me?" 中的 could 表示过去时态。
questions.questionCn: 判断正误："Could you help me?" 中的 could 表示过去时态。
questions.explanation: 错误。在请求帮助的疑问句中，could不表示过去，而是比can更委婉、更礼貌的说法。回答时要用can而不是could。

sections.name: if虚拟条件句总表
rows: If I were you, I would study harder.
If I had known, I would have helped you.
should do / were to do / did
If it should rain tomorrow, we would stay home.
从句和主句时间不一致
If you had taken my advice, you wouldn't be in trouble now.

sections.name: wish的虚拟语气
rows: I wish I were a bird.（我希望我是一只鸟）
I wish I had studied harder.（我真希望当时更努力）
I wish you would come tomorrow.（希望你明天能来）

items.rule: suggest / advise / propose / recommend + that从句（should + 动词原形，should可省）
examples: The doctor suggested that he (should) have a good rest.
I advise that you (should) start early.

items.rule: order / command / request / require / demand + that从句（should + 动词原形）
examples: The teacher ordered that all the students (should) hand in their homework.
The boss required that we (should) work overtime.

items.rule: It is important/necessary/essential/strange/natural + that从句
examples: It is important that we (should) learn English well.
It is necessary that he (should) come to the meeting.

items.rule: as if / as though（好像）引导的方式状语从句
examples: He talks as if he knew everything.（好像他什么都知道——其实不知道）
She looks as if she had seen a ghost.（好像见了鬼一样）

items.rule: if only（要是…就好了）
examples: If only I had more time.（要是我有更多时间就好了）
If only I had listened to you.（要是听了你的话就好了）

items.rule: would rather（宁愿）+ 从句
examples: I would rather you came tomorrow.（我宁愿你明天来）
I would rather you hadn't told me.（我宁愿你没告诉我）

questions.question: If I ___ you, I would accept the offer.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：如果我是你，我会接受这个提议。
questions.explanation: 这是与现在事实相反的虚拟语气。if从句用过去时，be动词一律用were（不管什么人称）。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：if从句与现在相反用were

questions.question: If I had studied harder, I ___ the exam.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：如果我当时更努力学习，我就通过考试了。
questions.explanation: 这是与过去事实相反的虚拟语气。if从句用had done，主句用would have done。
questions.knowledgePoint: 虚拟语气：与过去事实相反

questions.question: I wish I ___ fly like a bird.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：我希望我能像鸟一样飞。
questions.explanation: wish后面的宾语从句要用虚拟语气。对现在的虚拟用过去时，can的过去式是could。
questions.knowledgePoint: wish的虚拟语气：对现在的虚拟

questions.question: The doctor suggested that he ___ a good rest.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：医生建议他好好休息。
questions.explanation: suggest后面的宾语从句要用虚拟语气：(should) + 动词原形，should可以省略。所以用have。
questions.knowledgePoint: 建议命令类虚拟语气：suggest + (should) do

questions.question: "If I were you, I will go." 这句话是正确的虚拟语气。
questions.questionCn: 判断正误："If I were you, I will go." 这句话是正确的虚拟语气。
questions.explanation: 错误。与现在事实相反的虚拟语气，主句要用would/could/should/might + 动词原形，不能用will。正确形式是"If I were you, I would go."

sections.name: 三种非谓语动词对比表
rows: 主语、宾语、表语、定语、状语、补语
一般式to do / 进行式to be doing / 完成式to have done / 被动to be done
一般式doing / 完成式having done / 被动being done
一般式doing / 完成式having done / 被动being done
The boy running there is my brother.
只有一般式，表被动和完成
The book written by him is popular.

items.rule: 作主语：To + 动词原形 + 谓语（常用it作形式主语）
examples: To learn English is important.（= It is important to learn English.）
It is easy to answer this question.

items.rule: 作宾语：动词 + to do（want/hope/decide/plan/agree/refuse等）
examples: I want to go home.
She decided to study abroad.
He refused to help me.

items.rule: 作宾补：动词 + 宾语 + to do（ask/tell/invite/allow/encourage等）
examples: The teacher asked me to clean the classroom.
She encouraged me to try again.

items.rule: 省to的不定式：感官动词/使役动词 + 宾语 + 动词原形
examples: I saw him enter the room.（see/hear/watch/notice/feel）
He made me laugh.（make/let/have）
help后to可省可不省

items.rule: 疑问词 + to do 结构
examples: I don't know what to do.（= what I should do）
Can you tell me how to get there?
The question is when to start.

items.rule: too...to...（太…而不能） / enough to...（足够…能）
examples: He is too young to go to school.
She is old enough to go to school.

sections.name: 动名词用法 & to do vs doing 对比
rows: enjoy, finish, mind, practice, avoid, suggest, imagine, risk, keep, miss, consider, advise, allow, permit, escape, delay
I enjoy reading. / He finished writing.
want, hope, wish, decide, plan, agree, refuse, promise, offer, pretend, manage, fail, afford, happen, seem
这些动词后只能用to do
I want to go. / He decided to leave.
like, love, hate, prefer, begin, start, continue
I like to read. / I like reading.
记得要做 / 记得做过
Remember to lock the door. / I remember locking the door.
忘记要做 / 忘记做过
I forgot to buy milk. / I'll never forget meeting you.
遗憾要做 / 后悔做过
I regret to say no. / I regret telling him.
停下来去做另一件事 / 停止做某事
Stop to have a rest. / Stop talking, please.
努力/尽力做 / 试着做
Try to finish it on time. / Try adding some salt.
I mean to go. / Missing the bus means waiting.
需要做（主动） / 需要被做（被动）
I need to rest. / The bike needs repairing.

questions.question: I enjoy ___ books.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：我喜欢读书。
questions.explanation: enjoy后面只能接动名词（doing）作宾语，不能接不定式。类似的还有finish, mind, practice, avoid等。

questions.question: The teacher made me ___ the classroom.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：老师让我打扫教室。
questions.explanation: make是使役动词，后面接宾语+动词原形（省to的不定式）作宾补。类似的还有let, have以及感官动词see, hear等。
questions.knowledgePoint: 省to的不定式：make sb. do sth.

questions.question: Remember ___ the door when you leave.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：你走的时候记得锁门。
questions.explanation: remember to do表示"记得要做某事"（还没做）；remember doing表示"记得做过某事"（已经做了）。这里是提醒要锁门，用to lock。
questions.knowledgePoint: to do vs doing：remember to do vs remember doing

questions.question: ___ is believing.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：眼见为实。
questions.explanation: 这是一句谚语：Seeing is believing.（眼见为实）。动名词作主语，表语也用动名词保持对称。也可以说To see is to believe.

questions.question: "The bike needs repaired." 是正确的表达。
questions.questionCn: 判断正误："这辆自行车需要被修理"用"The bike needs repaired." 是正确的。
questions.explanation: 错误。need表示"需要被…"时，要用need doing（主动形式表被动含义）或need to be done。正确形式是"The bike needs repairing." 或 "The bike needs to be repaired."

sections.name: there be 句型表
rows: There is/are + 主语 + 地点
There is a book on the desk. / There are some books.
There was/were + 主语 + 地点
There was a meeting yesterday. / There were many people.
There will be / There is going to be
There will be a concert tomorrow.
There + 情态动词 + be + 主语
There must be a mistake. / There can be no doubt.
There is a book, isn't there?
be动词与最近的主语一致
There is a pen and two books.

items.rule: it作形式主语：代替后面的不定式/动名词/从句
examples: It is important to learn English.（真正主语：to learn English）
It is no use crying over spilt milk.（真正主语：crying...）
It is said that he is a good doctor.（真正主语：that从句）

items.rule: it作形式宾语：动词 + it + 宾补 + to do/that从句
examples: I find it easy to learn English.（真正宾语：to learn English）
We think it necessary that we should practice more.

items.rule: it指时间、天气、距离、温度等
examples: It is 8 o'clock.（时间）
It is raining.（天气）
It is 5 kilometers from here.（距离）
It is 30 degrees today.（温度）

items.rule: it用于强调句型：It is/was + 被强调部分 + that/who + 其他
examples: It was Tom who broke the window.（强调主语Tom）
It was yesterday that I met him.（强调时间yesterday）
It was in the park that I saw her.（强调地点in the park）

sections.name: 倒装句 & 感叹句
rows: Here/There + 谓语 + 主语（名词）
Here comes the bus. / There goes the bell.
主语是代词时不倒装：Here it is.
全部倒装（地点副词/介词短语放句首）
地点状语 + 谓语 + 主语
In front of the house stands a tree.
表方位的副词/介词短语
部分倒装（否定词放句首）
否定词 + 助动词/系动词 + 主语 + 谓语
Never have I seen such a thing. / Hardly did he know.
Only + 状语 + 助动词/系动词 + 主语 + 谓语
Only then did I realize my mistake. / Only in this way can we succeed.
only修饰状语放句首才倒装
So + 助动词/系动词 + 主语
He is a student. So am I.
Neither/Nor + 助动词/系动词 + 主语
He doesn't like it. Neither do I.
What + (a/an) + 形容词 + 名词 + 主语 + 谓语！
What a beautiful girl she is! / What good news it is!
How + 形容词/副词 + 主语 + 谓语！
How beautiful the girl is! / How fast he runs!

questions.question: There ___ a pen and two books on the desk.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：桌子上有一支钢笔和两本书。
questions.explanation: there be句型遵循就近原则，be动词与最近的主语a pen（单数）保持一致，所以用is。there be本身就表示"有"，不能和have同时用。

questions.question: It is important ___ English well.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：学好英语很重要。
questions.explanation: it作形式主语，真正的主语是后面的不定式to learn English well。结构是：It is + 形容词 + to do sth.
questions.knowledgePoint: it作形式主语：It is + adj. + to do

questions.question: ___ beautiful the flower is!
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：这朵花多漂亮啊！
questions.explanation: beautiful是形容词，用how引导感叹句。how修饰形容词或副词；what修饰名词。结构：How + 形容词/副词 + 主语 + 谓语！

questions.question: He likes music. ___.
questions.questionCn: 选择正确答案：他喜欢音乐。我也喜欢。
questions.explanation: "So + 助动词/系动词 + 主语"表示"…也一样"，用于肯定句后。主语不同需要倒装。So I do表示"确实如此"，主语相同不倒装。
questions.knowledgePoint: 倒装句：so + 助动词 + 主语（也一样）

questions.question: "There have a book on the desk." 是正确的句子。
questions.questionCn: 判断正误："There have a book on the desk." 是正确的句子。
questions.explanation: 错误。there be句型本身就表示"某地有某物"，be动词不能换成have。正确形式是"There is a book on the desk."
